cards.card_text: The LORD raises up a deliverer to save them: Othniel, son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz.
cards.verse_text: But when the Israelites cried out to the LORD, He raised up Othniel son of Caleb’s younger brother Kenaz as a deliverer to save them.
cards.snippet: …He raised up Othniel son of Caleb’s younger brother Kenaz as a deliverer to save them.

cards.card_text: Again they cry out to the LORD, and He raises up Ehud son of Gera, a left-handed Benjamite, as their deliverer.
cards.verse_text: And again they cried out to the LORD, and He raised up Ehud son of Gera, a left-handed Benjamite, as their deliverer.
cards.snippet: …He raised up Ehud son of Gera, a left-handed Benjamite, as their deliverer.

cards.card_text: Then David opens with a pile of names for God: rock, fortress, deliverer, shield, stronghold, refuge, Savior, and friend, he is NOT stopping.
cards.verse_text: He said: “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.
cards.snippet: He said: “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.

cards.verse_text: So the LORD gave Israel a deliverer, and they escaped the power of the Arameans.
cards.snippet: So the LORD gave Israel a deliverer, and they escaped the power of the Arameans.

cards.card_text: God hears from heaven and, in His great compassion, gives them deliverers who save them.
cards.verse_text: From heaven You heard them, and in Your great compassion You gave them deliverers who saved them from the hands of their enemies.
cards.snippet: …heaven You heard them, and in Your great compassion You gave them deliverers who saved them from the hands of their enemies.

cards.card_text: Then David starts piling up names for the LORD: my rock, my fortress, my deliverer, my shield, my stronghold.
cards.verse_text: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.
cards.snippet: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.

cards.card_text: His helper and deliverer His judge and lawgiver His Maker and King
cards.verse_text: You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.
cards.snippet: You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.

cards.card_text: Who does he say is his help and his deliverer?
cards.verse_text: You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.
cards.snippet: You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.

cards.card_text: Then David stacks up what the LORD is to him like he's loading a cookie box: steadfast love, fortress, stronghold, deliverer, shield.
cards.verse_text: He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer.
cards.snippet: He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer.

cards.card_text: The deliverers will ascend Mount Zion to rule over the mountains of Esau.
cards.verse_text: The deliverers will ascend Mount Zion to rule over the mountains of Esau.
cards.snippet: The deliverers will ascend Mount Zion to rule over the mountains of Esau.

cards.card_text: Paul backs it up with the prophet Isaiah (Isaiah 59:20-21; 27:9): 'The Deliverer will come from Zion; He will remove godlessness from Jacob.' That's Jacob, also called Israel (Genesis 32:28).
cards.verse_text: And so all Israel will be saved, as it is written: “The Deliverer will come from Zion; He will remove godlessness from Jacob.
cards.snippet: And so all Israel will be saved, as it is written: “The Deliverer will come from Zion; He will remove godlessness from Jacob.

cards.card_text: And Paul gives Him one more title: "Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath." Now THAT'S the One worth waiting on, friend.
cards.verse_text: and to await His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead—Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath.
cards.snippet: …await His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead—Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath.
